items.title: 'Tech Titan' Arora spearheads $1bn shot at NBA's London basketball team
items.summary: The US technology billionaire who led the acquisition of English cricket's most lucrative Hundred franchise is in talks to buy London's new NBA Europe team.  Sky News has learnt that Nikesh Arora, chief executive of the New York-listed cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks, is on a list of bidders being considered to acquire the latest addition to the capital's sports line-up.  Mr Arora last year assembled a group which instantly became known as the 'Tech Titans' when it bought a 49% stake in the Lords-based London Spirit Hundred team.
